title: Brazilian Beef Skewers with Smoky Flavor
description: A flavorful and spicy Brazilian-inspired dish featuring beef skewers with a smoky twist.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together smoky Brazilian sauce, unique seasoning blend, and Brazilian chimichurri.
Add the beef cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated beef onto the grill skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, or until the beef reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C) for medium-rare.
Let the skewers rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
Serve with fresh cilantro, lime wedges, and additional smoky Brazilian sauce if desired.
